rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something obviously unreasonable, ridiculous, or unacceptable.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2

rows.note: Use this when a remark, action, or idea makes no sense or is nonsensical, rather than merely improper.

example.english: What you just said was absurd.
example.traditional: 你啱啱嗰句真係無厘頭。
example.jyutping: nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 go2 geoi3 zan1 hai6 mou4 lei4 tau4

rows.note: Use this for a serious, logical, or philosophical claim that something is irrational or absurd, including an absurd reality.

example.english: Claiming that humans can never need sleep is absurd.
example.traditional: 話人類可以永遠唔使瞓覺，呢個講法太荒謬。
example.jyutping: waa6 jan4 leoi6 ho2 ji5 wing5 jyun5 m4 sai2 fan3 gaau3 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 taai3 fong1 mau6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a situation or existence is meaningless or has no value, not simply ridiculous.

example.english: Living like this every day is absurd.
example.traditional: 日日返工又唔做嘢，咁樣過日子真係冇意義。
example.jyutping: jat6 jat6 faan1 gung1 jau6 m4 zou6 je5 gam2 joeng6 gwo3 jat6 zi2 zan1 hai6 mou5 ji3 ji6
